  1. 若 \(R\in\mathcal R\)、\(\operatorname{ar}_{\mathcal R}(R)=n\) 且 \(\tau:n\to\mathsf{Tm}^{\Sigma}\)，则 \(\operatorname{rel}(R,\tau)\in\mathsf{Fm}_{NJ}^{\Sigma}\)；
  2. 若 \(s,t\in\mathsf{Tm}^{\Sigma}\)，则 \(\operatorname{eq}(s,t)\in\mathsf{Fm}_{NJ}^{\Sigma}\)；
  3. \(\bot\in\mathsf{Fm}_{NJ}^{\Sigma}\)；
  4. 若 \(A,B\in\mathsf{Fm}_{NJ}^{\Sigma}\)，则 \(\operatorname{and}(A,B)\)、\(\operatorname{or}(A,B)\)、\(\operatorname{imp}(A,B)\) 均属于 \(\mathsf{Fm}_{NJ}^{\Sigma}\)；
  5. 若 \(x\in\mathsf{Var}\) 且 \(A\in\mathsf{Fm}_{NJ}^{\Sigma}\)，则 \(\operatorname{all}(x,A)\) 与 \(\operatorname{ex}(x,A)\) 属于 \(\mathsf{Fm}_{NJ}^{\Sigma}\)。

\operatorname{RootedTree}(V,E,r)

\begin{aligned}
\operatorname{Discharge}_{NJ}(\bar J,J,D)
\Longleftrightarrow{}&
\exists\Gamma\,\exists A\,\exists B\,
\bigl[
\bar J=\langle\Gamma+[A]\triangleright B\rangle
\land J=\Gamma\triangleright\operatorname{imp}(A,B)
\land D=\{A\}
\bigr]
\\
&\lor
\exists\Gamma\,\exists\Delta\,\exists\Pi\,\exists A\,\exists B\,\exists C\,
\bigl[
\bar J=
\langle
\Gamma\triangleright\operatorname{or}(A,B),
\Delta+[A]\triangleright C,
\Pi+[B]\triangleright C
\rangle
\\
&\hspace{7em}\land J=\Gamma\cup\Delta\cup\Pi\triangleright C
\land D=\{A,B\}
\bigr]
\\
&\lor
\exists\Gamma\,\exists\Delta\,\exists A\,\exists C\,\exists x\,\exists y\,
\bigl[
\bar J=
\langle
\Gamma\triangleright\operatorname{ex}(x,A),
\Delta+[A[x:=\operatorname{var}(y)]]\triangleright C
\rangle
\\
&\hspace{7em}\land J=\Gamma\cup\Delta\triangleright C
\land y\notin\operatorname{FV}(\Gamma\cup\Delta\cup\{C\})
\land y\notin\operatorname{FV}(A)\setminus\{x\}
\land D=\{A[x:=\operatorname{var}(y)]\}
\bigr].
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}
\operatorname{NDCert}_{NJ}(\bar J,J,c)
\Longleftrightarrow{}&
\exists\Gamma\,\exists A\,
\bigl[c=(0,A)\land\bar J=()
\land J=\Gamma+[A]\triangleright A\bigr]
\\
&\lor
\bigl[c=(1,\varnothing)
\land(\bar J,J)\in\mathsf{Rule}_{keep}^{NJ}
\land\operatorname{Open}_{NJ}(J)=\operatorname{PremOpen}_{NJ}(\bar J)\bigr]
\\
&\lor
\exists D\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathsf{Fm}_{NJ}^{\Sigma})\,
\bigl[c=(2,D)
\land\operatorname{Discharge}_{NJ}(\bar J,J,D)
\land\operatorname{PremOpen}_{NJ}(\bar J)
=\operatorname{Open}_{NJ}(J)\cup D\bigr].
\end{aligned}

\operatorname{FRootLabTree}_{NJ}(T)
\Longleftrightarrow
\exists V\,\exists E\,\exists r\,\exists\operatorname{lab}\,
\bigl(
T=(V,E,r,\operatorname{lab})\land
V\subseteq_{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbb N\land r\in V\land
\operatorname{RootedTree}(V,E,r)\land
\operatorname{lab}:V\to\mathsf{Jud}_{NJ}
\bigr).
